Advertisement for Lady Medical Officer
Tuesday, 06 June 2017
6734 Hits
Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites applications along with complete bio-data with necessary academic experience certificates /testimonials for the post of Lady Medical Officer for KRHTC Anji center under the Department of Community Medicine which must reach the office of the Dean, MGIMS, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by
30th June
2017.
Qualification:
Recognized MBBS degree
Salary:
Consolidated Salary of Rs. 45000/- per month.
Age Limit:
35 years. Age can be relaxed for exceptional/ experienced candidates
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
